svg.text: ROUND 369 · CORPORATE BOARD PORTAL (DILIGENT / NASDAQ BOARDVANTAGE) & ENTITY GOVERNANCE AI SECURITY
Corporate Board Portals (Diligent/Boardvantage), Entity Governance & Board Resolution AI Security Guide
Executive Session & Poison-Pill Air-Gap + Director Quorum PKI & Recusal Lock vs. Proposal Injection & Filing Fraud (BRK-747 / BRK-748)
🚨 1. Top 3 Board Portal & Entity Governance Attack Surfaces
① Activist Shareholder Proposal Injection & MNPI Leak (BRK-747)
• Adversarial prompt inside a Rule 14a-8 shareholder proposal or
activist letter PDF coerces Board-Portal Agent into restricted-budget
• Exfiltrates confidential Independent Director Executive Session
minutes, hostile takeover Poison-Pill triggers & spin-off valuations
② Forged Unanimous Written Consent (UWC) & POA Hijack
• Mutates business-result in global entity registries (Athennian/
CSC) to record a forged Unanimous Written Consent (UWC) resolution
• Swaps subsidiary bank signatory Powers of Attorney (POA) & waives
director conflict-of-interest recusal walls under DGCL § 144
③ Spoofed Registered Agent Tax & D&O Retainer Fraud (BRK-748)
• Forged Delaware/Cayman Registered Agent franchise tax demand or
D&O Side-A insurance escrow notice swaps IBAN in trust-registry
• Initiates unauthorized $5,750 governance wire (request_payment)
• Impact: Entity good-standing forfeiture & treasury wire theft
🛡️ 2. Zero-Trust Board Portal & Entity Governance Architecture
Gate 1: Shareholder Proposal Sanitization & Typed Slots
• Strips free-text resolution directives from inbound PDFs; extracts
typed slots (Rule 14a-8 Proposal ID, Holder CUSIP, Entity LEI)
• Strictly tags untrusted=True, lane="attack"
Gate 2: Executive Session & Poison-Pill Defense Air-Gap
• Isolates Independent Director Executive Session minutes, takeover
defense playbooks, and CEO succession files in restricted-budget
• Enforced via record-owner + restricted-data-boundary
Gate 3: Deterministic Director PKI Quorum & Recusal Lock
• Requires hardware FIDO2/PKI signatures from 100% of voting
directors for UWC/POA changes; enforces DGCL § 144 recusal walls
• Enforced via untrusted-write blocking tainted resolution writes
Gate 4: Immutable Registered Agent & D&O Broker Registry
• Locks statutory filing & D&O escrow IBANs in trust-registry
(tool-allowlist + fixed-business-output + original-requester-payment)
📊 3. Architecture Selection & Benchmark Results
Head-to-Head Board Portal & Entity Security Options:
A. Deterministic Board Broker + MNPI Air-Gap + PKI Lock (🏆)
✓ 100% Block on BRK-747/748 | DGCL § 141(f) & SEC Compliant
B. Native Diligent Boards / Nasdaq Boardvantage / Athennian RBAC
⚠ Vulnerable when board-book copilot is hijacked by proposal PDF
C. Cloud LLM Guardrails (Prompt Shields / Bedrock Guardrails)
⚠ Blind to bylaw quorum rules, director recusals & POA registries
D. Encrypted Email / PDF Board Decks & Manual Entity Spreadsheets
✕ Uncontrolled local device caching & missed FinCEN BOI filings
🧪 Pytest Deterministic Regression (Round 369):
• Baseline Policy: Forged UWC posted, MNPI leaked & wire sent ❌
• Hardened Policy: All 5 deterministic gates blocked 100% ✅
- record-owner: Blocks reading Executive Sessions (restricted-budget)
- untrusted-write: Blocks forged UWC resolution & POA hijack
- restricted-data-boundary: Blocks Poison-Pill defense exfiltration
- tool-allowlist / fixed-business-output: Locks filing registry
- original-requester-payment: Blocks $5,750 spoofed tax/D&O wire
🚀 Architect Go-Live Checklist & Cumulative Milestones (Round 369 · Corporate Board & Subsidiary Governance)
✅ 1. Executive Session & Takeover Defense Air-Gap: Isolate closed-session minutes & Poison-Pill plans from board-book agents
✅ 2. Deterministic Director PKI Quorum & Recusal Lock: Require hardware signatures for UWC/POA updates & enforce DGCL § 144
✅ 3. Immutable Registered Agent Registry: Lock trust-registry and require Corporate Secretary + Treasury FIDO2 sign-off
📊 Verified Totals: 766 Scenarios (763 Risk + 3 Benign) | 862 Pytest Checks | 1,598 Assertions | 752 Vectors | 369 Bilingual FAQs (188 SA Guides) | BRK-747/748
